title: Fix class spellcasting feature segmentation (Cleric/Wizard/etc.)
description: Deficiency #3. Spellcasting facts are fragmented/misplaced: Cleric full mechanics sit under feature:cleric:cantrips while feature:cleric:spellcasting is a one-sentence stub; Wizard Cantrips/Spellbook/Spellcasting are split so feature:wizard:spellcasting is just an intro while actionable spellbook/preparation mechanics live elsewhere. Pick ONE canonical model and apply consistently: either (a) feature:<class>:spellcasting owns all spellcasting prose+structured metadata with child subsections, or (b) distinct cantrips/spellbook/spellcasting records each complete, linked, and progression-granted. Pack must encode facts like 'Wizard starts with six spellbook spells', 'Cleric prepares Wisdom modifier + level', 'Bard is a Charisma known-caster' WITHOUT consumer overlays. Coordinates with the spellcasting half of the overlay-absorption bead.
